Is 63 too old to take on a triathlon? Absolutely not! Discover how staying active, training smart, and building endurance can help you pursue big fitness goals at any age—and why it's never too late to challenge yourself.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
